$comment: Caps for npm run release-check (tools/release-check/release-check.mjs). Raise a cap only with the measurement that justifies it; allow-list a duplicate or failed request only with a reason a reviewer can check. Warnings: allowed-warnings.json.

budgets.$comment: Per page view, from every archer-budget/1 block (harness runs and the page-load lab). The first view of a run downloads the debug page (~3.6 MB); later views get 304s.
budgets.$thumbnails: Thumbnail images are counted apart from API requests: every page fetches ahead, once per browser session and at low priority, up to 24 thumbnails (THUMBNAIL_PREFETCH_LIMIT) for each listed project; the corpus has 3 projects (25 views).
budgets.$timing: Lab timings (lcpMs, wallMs, longTaskMs) over their cap are WARN; timingFailFactor null never fails them. On a busy shared host they ran 2-4x the seed. On a quiet or dedicated host set e.g. 2 (fail above 2x the cap).

full.$comment: lib.mjs files are helpers; *probe* and *-dbg* files dump state for a person and assert nothing.

scale.$comment: tools/perf/scale-gates.mjs (performance plan slice 1): counts on the debug page over generated corpora, each size in a sandbox of its own. S = today's corpus, M = 250 views / 1k notes / 200 threads. Quick runs S only (M takes about 2 more minutes); the full run does S and M. L (1,000 views, a 257-view project) is opt-in: ARCHER_SCALE_L=1. Caps and the slices that should tighten them: tools/perf/scale-budgets.json.

lab.$comment: lab-budgets.json is seeded from a sandbox of this corpus (tools/perf/history/budgets-2026-10-20.json, retired 2026-11-02 per the performance rubric §8: a long-running service, another corpus and machine, caps of 24–284 requests and 7 duplicates allowed). Re-seed: page-load.mjs --runs 3 --write-budget tools/release-check/lab-budgets.json against a fresh sandbox.
